name: Doki Doki Exit Music
source:
The definitive Natsuki experience, fully updated since release with new and changed content! Exit Music is a somber tale focusing on everyone’s favorite pink-haired tsundere, an emotional thrill ride from beginning to end. Along with Natsuki herself, the rest of the literature club faces serious changes and dilemmas that tie-in to the main story. With an emotional, romantic, and heart-wrenching story, a heartfelt soundtrack, along with custom sprites and backgrounds, you are sure to feel every moment of Exit Music’s impactful journey, even long after it has ended. Exit Music deals with heavy topics and dark themes, carefully put together to deliver an unforgettable experience.

[From [url=https://dokimods.me/mods/exit-music] DokiMods[/url]]
